Name: Nude mode for 1.4
Author: priority02
Description:
I made this mod for personal use. But in case if someone wants it I would like to share it. This is a simple nude mod for Stardew Vally 1.4 version. Only for farmers not for the NPC. And only for the specific skin number: 23 for male and 24 for female. No genitals and body-specific features. It merely removes your underwear when you remove your cloth manually. The reason for the specific skin number is that the naked shoulder parts are the parts of the shirts. Bottom will work for any skin color.

If you go to the public bath, you might not be the naked guy.

You can change the skin number compatibility if you want. Unpack shirts.xnb file with xnbcli and recolor the arm parts with your desired color. 

Installation
Put both files to ...

\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer\

... and override it.
